newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's August inflation 4.1 pct -- Matos.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's August inflation 4.1 pct -- Matos.

text.p: Venezuela's inflation rate in August was 4.1 percent, down from 5.0 percent in July, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said Monday.
Matos gave the August inflation figure in answer to a reporter's question as he left presidential palace Miraflores.
Venezuela's Central Bank was due to announce the official August inflation rate later on Monday.
Matos made no comment on the inflation figure.
Accumulated inflation over the last 12 months stood at 122.6 percent at the end of July.
Matos has said the annual inflation rate will end 1996 at 95 percent, up from 56.6 percent in 1995.
